title: Console: Region pinning settings UI + inline validation (behind feature flag)
author: Nora Ahmed
body:
Summary: Adds the Console UI for Hosted/Dedicated data residency region pinning settings, including inline validation, guardrail copy, and error-state UX for common residency enforcement errors. The UI is behind the feature flag `residency_console_settings_ui` and is only visible to users with the new RBAC permission to manage residency settings (wired via backend in PR #18489).

Key behaviors: (1) Settings surface: Org Settings → Security & Compliance → Data Residency. Supports two policy modes as per ADR-042: `pinned_region` (single select) and `allowed_regions` (multi-select). Enforces precedence rules in the UI: when `pinned_region` is set, `allowed_regions` is shown as read-only explanatory context and is derived/validated to contain the pinned region. (2) Inline validation: prevents invalid combinations (empty allowed list, pinned not in allowed, unknown region codes, attempted cross-product selection e.g., Dedicated org trying to set region not enabled for that org). Validation runs on change and again on save; server errors are mapped to field-level messages where possible. (3) Error UX copy: Adds an error banner component used by the settings page and shared “residency violation” callouts used by other Console surfaces (Requests page, Traces drilldown) when the API returns residency enforcement errors. Includes remediation guidance: check base URL/region, confirm org policy, and link to internal docs slug `docs/data-residency#troubleshooting` (link is environment-aware). (4) Feature flag + rollout: routes and nav item are registered but gated. If the flag is off, deep-linking to the settings page returns a 404-style “Not enabled” page rather than leaking the control.

Why: Enterprise pilots asked for a self-serve way to confirm and manage region pinning and to reduce Support load from `RESIDENCY_REGION_MISMATCH` incidents (misconfigured SDK base URL / wrong region endpoint). This PR focuses on UI/UX and validation; enforcement behavior is handled by gateway/routing PRs.

Out of scope: (a) Violation summary charts (planned follow-up once metrics panels are stable). (b) Exception request workflow UI (handled by Security/GRC process doc + Support playbook). (c) Private/VPC configuration surface (Private has different controls; will be scoped separately).

Testing: Added unit tests for validation logic and component rendering; Playwright smoke for the settings save flow with stubbed API responses (success + server-side validation error + forbidden). Manual: verified in staging with flag on, using an enterprise pilot org configured for eu-west pinning.

Screenshots: Included in the internal PR attachments (Settings page states: empty/default, pinned-region set, allowed-regions multi-select, server error banner).

Rollout notes: Keep `residency_console_settings_ui` disabled by default. Naomi + Chris will coordinate enabling for pilot cohort only once the docs PR lands.
commits: console(residency): add Data Residency settings route + feature flag gating
console(residency): implement pinned/allowed region selectors + validation
console(residency): map residency error codes to remediation copy + docs link
test(console): add validation unit tests and Playwright smoke coverage
chore(console): refactor shared Banner + EmptyState for settings pages
conversation:
Dylan Brooks (review): Can we make sure the flag gates both nav visibility and direct route access? Also please confirm we’re not introducing any public strings we can’t tweak quickly during beta.

Nora Ahmed (author): Updated route loader to hard-gate on `residency_console_settings_ui` and return NotEnabled. Nav item is also gated. Copy is centralized in `errorCopy.ts` so we can iterate quickly; no hard-coded strings in the page.

Chloe Martin (review): Validation: If pinned_region is set, should we allow allowed_regions editing at all? ADR-042 says precedence is pinned > allowed; but customers might expect the multi-select to still matter.

Nora Ahmed (author): Made allowed_regions read-only when pinned is set (with explanation). If pinned is cleared, allowed becomes editable again. This matches the current backend semantics we expose via #18489.

Naomi Feldman (review): Copy request: For region mismatch errors we should explicitly tell them to check their SDK base URL (api.us vs api.eu) and confirm their org pin. Also add a sentence about “no cross-region fallback when pinned” to set expectations.

Nora Ahmed (author): Updated remediation bullets for RESIDENCY_REGION_MISMATCH and added a pinned policy expectation note. The “no fallback” sentence only shows when the org has pinned_region set (based on settings payload).

Marcus Lin (review): Please ensure we don’t leak exact region topology in error messages beyond the customer’s configured regions. Also confirm permission gating uses RBAC, not just the feature flag.

Nora Ahmed (author): Error UI only references `requested_region` and `effective_region` from the API error payload, and only displays allowed regions as returned by settings API for that org. Permission gating: page checks `org.residency:write`; otherwise shows a 403 panel and hides save controls.

Felix Schneider (review): Small UX nit: when server rejects due to stale settings, can we render field-level error instead of banner-only?

Nora Ahmed (author): Added mapping for `RESIDENCY_POLICY_VALIDATION_FAILED` to attach to the relevant field when the backend returns `field=pinned_region|allowed_regions` metadata; otherwise falls back to banner.

Approvals: Dylan Brooks approved. Chloe Martin approved. Naomi Feldman approved. Marcus Lin approved.

Merge: Squashed and merged after green CI; flag remains default-off.
